[api]
memo.get(taskId, name) -> the memo value or null; answered at once
memo.put(taskId, name, candidate) -> the durable winner; answered after the memo's commit is applied
snapshot(doc) -> the document state or null; answered at once
snapshotAsOf(doc, at) -> the document state at entry at or null; answered at once
watch.open(doc, view or graph target, watchId) -> the first frame; answered at once; later frames arrive as published notices carrying watchId
watch.close(watchId) -> null; answered at once
getTask(taskId) -> the task record or null; answered at once
waitForTask(taskId) -> the settled receipt; answered when the task is terminal and published
waitForIdle(conversationId (optional: every ownerless conversation)) -> null; answered in the same step when the scope has no live non-background task; else when the scheduler settles the scope idle; `Harness is closed` once the Harness closed
submission(submissionId, wait (optional: the read is Submissions.wait's, not status's)) -> the submission record, or null; answered a Session line job that reads the record once
scanEntries(query, limit, cursor) -> the page of entries; answered a Session line job that reads one page (Conversation.entries)
outcomes(taskIds) -> the outcomes in order, or an error naming the missing one; answered at once
ownedTasks(by (the invoking task)) -> copies of the live tasks it owns directly, in ID order; an error once its invocation has ended; answered at once
entry(conversationId, entryId) -> the entry record or null; answered at once
context(conversationId, at) -> the ContextView; answered at once
conversation(conversationId) -> the conversation handle data or null; answered at once
agent(conversationId) -> the resolved agent; answered at once
sleepUntil(taskId, until, checkpoint) -> null; answered once the sleep is committed; the task then holds no invocation
wake() -> {active, at?}; answered at once
retryTask(taskId) -> null; answered once a parked task's restart count is cleared and scheduling is enabled; an error for an unknown task
usage() -> the UsageState of the Session; answered at once
taskGraph() -> the TaskGraph; answered at once
[layout]
step := u32 size, u8 status, u16 nCommits, u16 nReads, u16 nNotices, u16 nEffects, commit*, read*, notice*, effect*, order, [status != 0: u32 len, error JSON]
size and len count the bytes after their own field; the step is size + 4 bytes long
the step export returns the address of its parts := u32 n, (u32 ptr, u32 len){n}; the step is the concatenation of the n byte ranges, the first holding size
commit := u32 len, i64 seq, u16 nStmts, stmt*
stmt := u16 sqlId, u8 nParams, value*
read := u32 readId, u16 sqlId, u8 nParams, value*
a step with reads has no effects; the host applies its commits, in order, before it runs its reads
notice := u8 kind, u32 origin, u32 len, payload
effect := u32 effectId, u8 kind, u32 origin, u32 len, payload
origin: 0 for none, else the host's tag of the async context (AsyncLocalStorage snapshot) the notice's listeners or the effect's handler run in; the step export's origin argument tags the host call an event comes from; a hops effect has origin 0
order := u16 n, (u8 region, u16 index)*; n is 0 (all notices, then all effects) or nNotices + nEffects, region 0 notice, 1 effect, listing them in Pi's synchronous order; the builder emits it only when the step has both
rows-event := u16 nReads, (u32 readId, u32 nRows, u8 nCols, value{nRows*nCols})*
model_bytes phase: 0 head, 1 chunk, 2 end, 3 error
tool_progress waitId is always present: nonzero only for kind 1, whose details update is answered by a progress_ack notice
tool_progress kind: 0 output, 1 details, 2 diagnostic
outcome: 0 result, 1 thrown
memStats: 8 x u64: arena, index, derived, documents, scratch, total live, heap in use, linear memory size
allocStats: 3 x u64: bytes allocated, allocations, completed collections; read without a collection
